spec.name: sensor_housing_bracket
spec.description: Sensor housing bracket, 80 x 50 x 40 mm envelope, y up. Bottom face (y=0) bolted to the chassis over its full area; the sensor head pushes 200 N in -x on a 10 x 10 mm pad at the centre of the x=80 end face. The connector-plug keep-out is NOT modelled because the brief gives no size or position for it (see meta.open_questions).

supports.note: Bottom face y=0 bolted to the chassis over its full area

loads.note: 10 x 10 mm pad at the centre of the x=80 end face (y=25, z=20), 200 N total along -x

assumptions: Aluminium 6061 taken as E = 68.9 GPa (68900 MPa), nu = 0.33
Full clamp (x, y, z) on the bolted base face
open_questions: Connector plug keep-out: the brief says to leave room at the front but gives no dimensions or location. 'Front' is ambiguous with y up; it is most likely the z+ face, but could be x+, which carries the load. Add a void passive region once the plug envelope (size and position) is known.
